payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the post-processing approaches used to restore special tokens to their original numerical values in the translated sentences.

claims.text: In post-processing, special tokens <NUMBER> and <DATE> are replaced with the corresponding numbers detected in the original source sentences.
The post-processing includes detecting complex patterns like <NUMBER> / <NUMBER> and replacing them with the corresponding numbers from the source sentences.
A rescoring mechanism is used in post-processing to select translation candidates for fluency and consistency.
